abstract: Self-contained plugin-facing design system for hoardodile: how the host themes a plugin iframe (applyTheme/applyFonts, palette/iconStyle/fonts context), the token vocabulary shipped in @hoardodile/ui theme.css (type scale, ten color roles, radius family, two shadows, container widths, control heights, motion durations and easings), iconography rules (registry, Icon tiers, duotone via --icon-tone, marks), recommended components, states, overlays, motion principles, and a pre-ship checklist.
